global_option.name: --active-name
tip: Override device autodetection of the dm device to reencrypt.

global_option.name: --align-payload
tip: Align the payload at this many sector boundaries.

global_option.name: --allow-discards
tip: Allow discard (TRIM) requests for the device.

global_option.name: --batch-mode
tip: Do not ask for confirmation.

global_option.name: --block-size
tip: Reencryption block size.

global_option.name: --cancel-deferred
tip: Cancel a previously set deferred device removal.

global_option.name: --cipher
tip: The cipher used to encrypt the disk (see /proc/crypto).

global_option.name: --debug
tip: Show debug messages.

global_option.name: --debug-json
tip: Show debug messages including JSON metadata.

global_option.name: --decrypt
tip: Decrypt a LUKS2 device by removing encryption.

global_option.name: --deferred
tip: Defer device removal until the last user closes it.

global_option.name: --device-size
tip: Use only the specified device size (DANGEROUS).

global_option.name: --disable-blkid
tip: Disable blkid on-disk signature detection and wiping.

global_option.name: --disable-external-tokens
tip: Disable loading of external LUKS2 token plugins.

global_option.name: --disable-keyring
tip: Disable loading volume keys via the kernel keyring.

global_option.name: --disable-locks
tip: Disable locking of on-disk metadata.

global_option.name: --disable-veracrypt
tip: Do not scan for a VeraCrypt compatible device.

global_option.name: --dump-json-metadata
tip: Dump info in JSON format (LUKS2 only).

global_option.name: --dump-volume-key
tip: Dump the volume key instead of keyslots info.

global_option.name: --dump-volume-key-file
tip: Write the volume key to this file.

global_option.name: --encrypt
tip: Encrypt a LUKS2 device in place.

global_option.name: --external-tokens-path
tip: Path to the directory with external token handlers.

global_option.name: --force-offline-reencrypt
tip: Force offline LUKS2 reencryption and bypass active device detection.

global_option.name: --force-password
tip: Disable the password quality check.

global_option.name: --hash
tip: The hash used to create the encryption key from the passphrase.

global_option.name: --header
tip: Device or file with a separated LUKS header.

global_option.name: --header-backup-file
tip: File with a LUKS header and keyslots backup.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show this help message.

global_option.name: --hotzone-size
tip: Maximal reencryption hotzone size.

global_option.name: --hw-opal
tip: Use HW OPAL encryption together with SW encryption.

global_option.name: --hw-opal-factory-reset
tip: Wipe the whole OPAL disk on luksErase.

global_option.name: --hw-opal-only
tip: Use only HW OPAL encryption.

global_option.name: --init-only
tip: Initialize LUKS2 reencryption in metadata only.

global_option.name: --integrity
tip: Data integrity algorithm (LUKS2 only).

global_option.name: --integrity-legacy-padding
tip: Use inefficient legacy padding for old kernels.

global_option.name: --integrity-no-journal
tip: Disable the journal for the integrity device.

global_option.name: --integrity-no-wipe
tip: Do not wipe the device after format.

global_option.name: --iter-time
tip: PBKDF iteration time for LUKS in milliseconds.

global_option.name: --iv-large-sectors
tip: Count the IV in sector size instead of 512-byte units.

global_option.name: --json-file
tip: Read or write the JSON from or to a file.

global_option.name: --keep-key
tip: Do not change the volume key.

global_option.name: --key-description
tip: Key description in the keyring.

global_option.name: --key-file
tip: Read the key from this file.

global_option.name: --key-size
tip: The size of the encryption key.

global_option.name: --key-slot
tip: Slot number for the new key (default is first free).

global_option.name: --keyfile-offset
tip: Number of bytes to skip in the keyfile.

global_option.name: --keyfile-size
tip: Limit the read from the keyfile.

global_option.name: --keyslot-cipher
tip: LUKS2 keyslot cipher.

global_option.name: --keyslot-key-size
tip: LUKS2 keyslot key size.

tip: Set a label for the LUKS2 device.

tip: LUKS2 header metadata area size.

global_option.name: --new

global_option.name: --new-keyfile

global_option.name: --new-keyfile-offset
tip: Number of bytes to skip in the newly added keyfile.

tip: Limit the read from the newly added keyfile.

global_option.name: --new-token-id

global_option.name: --offset

tip: PBKDF parallel cost.

global_option.name: --perf-submit_from_crypt_cpus

global_option.name: --priority
tip: Keyslot priority.

global_option.name: --progress-frequency
tip: Progress line update interval in seconds.

global_option.name: --progress-json
tip: Print progress data in JSON format.

global_option.name: --readonly
tip: Create a read-only mapping.

global_option.name: --reduce-device-size

global_option.name: --refresh
tip: Refresh (reactivate) the device with new parameters.

global_option.name: --resilience
